messages:
maggie: quick follow-up from the 04/12 PM re: recurring tail-latency pattern. proposal: add a compact triage checklist to the runbook, include copy-paste-safe commands + sample output, and add a 'pattern-match' flag on PMs to route repeats to Pattern Board.

rachel: love it. short checklist wins during oncall.

devon: suggested checklist order: 1) confirm impacted customers/models, 2) verify model-variant fallback, 3) check prefix/KV cache stats, 4) inspect autoscaler backlog, 5) consider immediate model downscale/fallback.

anya: for automation tests I'll need exact CLI checks. propose these (copy/paste):
redwoodctl cache stats --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --json
# expected snippet: {"hit_rate":0.87,"evictions":12,"median_ttfb_ms":45} 
redwoodctl model get-config --model=redwood-alpha --show-fallbacks
kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-hpa -o yaml
curl -sS -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://inference.svc/healthz

samir: owners & deadlines: devon -> runbook PR in 48h, anya -> test harness in 5 days, rachel -> update PM template + pattern routing in 24h. I'll create the tracking ticket and verify closures.

maggie: add a safe hotfix snippet (DANGER callout):
redwoodctl cache flush --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --confirm
# DANGER: only if cache corruption confirmed; flush is destructive.

rachel: escalation SLA suggestion: oncall -> runtime lead within 20m, runtime -> platform within 45m if unresolved. add after-hours SMS step.

ops-bot: Created task INCIDENT-5250 "Runbook: compact triage checklist + pattern flag" assigned to samir, due 2026-04-15.

devon: I'll include sample outputs and a short troubleshooting note for low hit_rate / rising evictions.

maggie: recap owners: devon (runbook) 48h, anya (automation) 5d, rachel (PM template + routing) 24h, samir (ticket + verify) tomorrow. posting checklist to incidents board now. closing thread unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
